headline: Oil Prices Plummet Over 7% as Iran-US Peace Talks Signal Supply Ease
summary: Crude oil prices fell more than 7%, with Brent threatening to drop below $100 per barrel as negotiations between Iranian and Qatari authorities sparked optimism for an end to Middle East conflict.
why: Geopolitical developments in the Middle East heavily influence global crude supply expectations. Lower geopolitical risk premiums typically drive down oil benchmarks, impacting energy sector equities and commodity-linked currencies.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Peace negotiations easing Middle East supply fears directly reduce crude oil futures prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Negotiations between Iranian and Qatari authorities fueled hopes of an end to the Middle East conflict, alleviating supply disruption fears and causing oil prices to drop significantly.
